verses.he: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.'

verses.he: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃
verses.en: So let the redeemed of the LORD say, Whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary;

verses.he: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃
verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the sea.

verses.he: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

verses.he: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃
verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

verses.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.en: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.en: And He led them by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: כִּי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: For He hath satisfied the longing soul, And the hungry soul He hath filled with good.

verses.he: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.en: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron—

verses.he: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃
verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High.

verses.he: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃
verses.en: Therefore He humbled their heart with travail, They stumbled, and there was none to help—

verses.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.en: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.

verses.he: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their bands in sunder. .

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: כִּֽי־שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃
verses.en: For He hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.he: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲו‍ֹֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.en: Crazed because of the way of their transgression, And afflicted because of their iniquities—

verses.he: כָּל־אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near unto the gates of death—

verses.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.en: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses;

verses.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: He sent His word, and healed them, And delivered them from their graves.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃
verses.en: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with singing.

verses.he: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters—

verses.he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃
verses.en: These saw the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep;

verses.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃
verses.en: For He commanded, and raised the stormy wind, Which lifted up the waves thereof;

verses.he: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
verses.en: They mounted up to the heaven, they went down to the deeps; Their soul melted away because of trouble;

verses.he: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכָל־חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃
verses.en: They reeled to and fro, and staggered like a drunken man, And all their wisdom was swallowed up—

verses.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃
verses.en: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.

verses.he: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He made the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof were still.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃
verses.en: Then were they glad because they were quiet, And He led them unto their desired haven.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃
verses.en: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the seat of the elders.

verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃
verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

verses.he: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: A fruitful land into a salt waste, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

verses.he: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.en: And there He maketh the hungry to dwell, And they establish a city of habitation;

verses.he: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃
verses.en: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, Which yield fruits of increase.

verses.he: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃
verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly, And suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.he: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Again, they are minished and dwindle away Through oppression of evil and sorrow.

verses.he: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

verses.he: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Yet setteth He the needy on high from affliction, And maketh his families like a flock.

verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.en: The upright see it, and are glad; And all iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

verses.he: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, And let them consider the mercies of the LORD.
